title: WEF 2020 report names Steven Kelly and Mike Shanahan as FBI contributors
summary: The report's acknowledgement list names two FBI contributors and does not name Brett Leatherman.

sources.title: Partnership against Cybercrime
sources.notes: Acknowledgements list United States Federal Bureau of Investigation — Steven Kelly, Mike Shanahan.

data.claim: The named FBI contributors in the WEF 2020 Partnership against Cybercrime report are Steven Kelly and Mike Shanahan; Brett Leatherman is not named in the acknowledgement list.
data.adjudication: Official report text supports the named contributors; absence is limited to the acknowledgement list.

caveats: Absence from the acknowledgement list does not prove absence from every meeting or informal consultation.
